for ti,t in enumerate(D3):
  tx=max(c for r in t for c,v in enumerate(r) if v==9)
  for si,s in enumerate(D3):
    sx=max(c for r in s for c,v in enumerate(r) if v==9)
    if sx<=tx or si==ti: continue
    best=(0,None)
    for d in range(-5,6): # target x maps src x-d
      match=valid=0
      for i in range(3):
        for x in range(tx+1):
          q=x-d
          if 0<=q<16:
            valid+=1; match+=(t[i][x]==s[i][q])
      sc=match/valid
      if sc>best[0]: best=(sc,d,valid)
    print('target',ti,tx,'source',si,sx,'best',best)
